brief:
An Israeli airstrike struck the Nahr al-Bared camp south of Khan Younis on Thursday, killing one Palestinian and wounding another, Shehab Wire reported. The strike targeted the refugee encampment in southern Gaza.

The attack represents another violation of the ceasefire agreement governing Gaza, according to the agency. Israeli forces have continued to breach the truce terms since it took effect.

title: Israeli airstrike kills Palestinian in Khan Younis
